prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1488
Claimant:
Donna Morris
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
2023-10-10
Claim opened after the insured reported a left-turn collision at an intersection, with the claimant's vehicle struck on the
driver's side. Initial file review started and a photo request went out to the insured.
2023-11-11
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was active at the time of the loss. No issues with
policy status found.
2023-11-20
Police report received. It places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene and matches the general description the
insured gave.
2023-11-29
Photos from the insured and the claimant's side show the damage concentrated where the impact would be
expected, and the overall pattern fits the described collision.
2023-12-20
Vehicle inspection completed. Most of the damage lines up with the reported impact, and no prior damage to the
vehicle appears in our records or in the appraiser's notes.
2023-12-29
Claimant is represented by counsel. All communication now routes through the attorney's office, and a letter of
representation is on file.
2024-01-04
Reviewed the medical summary from the first treatment visit. The neck and back strain described is consistent with
the force of this type of crash, and no earlier injury to the same area is known from prior records.
2024-01-11
Treatment followed a typical course of care, with visits becoming less frequent as the claimant's symptoms eased.
Notes indicate steady improvement over the period.
2024-03-08
No independent witnesses have come forward. The photos confirm several details of the collision, but the account
rests mainly on the parties and the police report.
2024-04-08
The claimant has given the same account of the collision in each contact so far, including the recorded statement, the
attorney's letter, and the follow-up call.
2024-04-29
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy's effective date. Coverage timeline checked against the
vehicle's loss history and found clear.
2024-05-06
File is in order for the next stage of evaluation. Bodily injury and propetry damage reserves reviewed, and the claim
remains open pending the attorney's demand package.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
